arabic_html:
وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ
أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ
فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ ۞
translation: And when My servants ask you concerning Me — indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me and believe in Me, that they may be rightly guided.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr relates the ḥadīth: no sincere duʿāʾ is ever wasted. Allah either hastens the answer, saves it for the Hereafter, or turns away a harm of equal measure.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathir relates the hadith: no sincere prayer is ever wasted. Allah either hastens the answer, saves it for the Hereafter, or turns away a harm of equal measure.
